title: Multi-Faceted Evaluation of Tool-Augmented Dialogue Systems
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (TRACE) and a framework (SCOPE) for evaluating tool-augmented dialogue systems. While it contains a brief 'Ethical Considerations' section and mentions 'Security Overkill' as an error case, its core focus is on technical performance metrics (accuracy, task completion, tool-usage) rather than benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
